route_text: {"target_smiles":"NC(=O)c1cccc2c1c1c(OCC(=O)O)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"目标分子为具有特定取代的咔唑衍生物（sPLA2抑制剂类似物），其核心骨架由包含9位苄基、4位羧甲氧基和5位甲酰胺基的咔唑环系组成。逆合成分析首先考虑在最晚阶段进行保护基去除与官能团修饰，即通过羧酸酯的水解得到游离羧酸基团。倒数第二步，5位甲酰胺基可通过氰基在碱性双氧水或酸催化下水解获得，或者直接经由酰胺化反应引入。对于酚羟基侧链，可在酚羟基存在下与溴乙酸叔丁酯进行烷基化构建醚键。咔唑核心的构建是该路线的关键，通过经典的Cadogan环化或Buchwald-Hartwig双重胺化反应形成。更收敛且高效的策略是采用芳基-芳基偶联（Suzuki偶联）连接两个功能化的苯环前体，随后发生分子内C-N键偶联环化构筑中间吡咯环，或者利用联苯胺衍生物进行环化。在此，我们设计从2,6-二溴苯甲腈与功能化苯硼酸出发，经Suzuki-Miyaura交叉偶联得到联苯骨架，随后通过分子内硝基还原环化（Cadogan反应）或Buchwald-Hartwig胺化闭环构建咔唑骨架。接着在咔唑氮上进行苄基化，去甲基化释放4位酚羟基，再与溴乙酸乙酯烷基化，最后水解腈基为伯酰胺并皂化酯基得到目标产物。","key_disconnection_class":"Ester hydrolysis","disconnection_type":"fgi","planned_num_steps":6,"strategy":"晚期酯水解与醚化，咔唑核心经偶联与环化构筑","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"NC(=O)c1cccc2c1c1c(OCC(=O)O)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","precursors":["CCOC(=O)COc1cccc2c1c1c(C(N)=O)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Ester hydrolysis"},{"step_id":2,"product":"CCOC(=O)COc1cccc2c1c1c(C(N)=O)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","precursors":["CCOC(=O)COc1cccc2c1c1c(C#N)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Nitrile hydration"},{"step_id":3,"product":"CCOC(=O)COc1cccc2c1c1c(C#N)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","precursors":["N#Cc1cccc2c1c1c(O)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","CCOC(=O)CBr"],"reaction_class":"Williamson ether synthesis"},{"step_id":4,"product":"N#Cc1cccc2c1c1c(O)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","precursors":["COc1cccc2c1c1c(C#N)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Ether cleavage"},{"step_id":5,"product":"COc1cccc2c1c1c(C#N)cccc1n2Cc1ccccc1","precursors":["COc1cccc2[nH]c3cccc(C#N)c3c12","BrCc1ccccc1"],"reaction_class":"Amine alkylation"},{"step_id":6,"product":"COc1cccc2[nH]c3cccc(C#N)c3c12","precursors":["COc1cccc(N)c1-c1c(Br)cccc1C#N"],"reaction_class":"Buchwald-Hartwig amination"}],"starting_materials":["BrCc1ccccc1","CCOC(=O)CBr","COc1cccc(N)c1-c1c(Br)cccc1C#N"]}]}

route_text: {"target_smiles":"O=c1[nH]c2cc(-c3ccncc3F)c(-c3ccccc3F)nc2[nH]1","routes":[{"strategy_plan":"本逆合成路线针对目标分子咪唑并[4,5-b]吡啶-2-酮衍生物的结构特征，采取后期环状脲构筑与化学选择性分步Suzuki-Miyaura交叉偶联策略。首先，第一步逆合成切断咪唑并吡啶-2-酮的双环核心，通过1,1'-羰基二咪唑与吡啶-2,3-二胺中间体缩合构筑五元环状脲，显著简化了杂环母核的合成。二胺中间体可由对应的3-硝基吡啶-2-胺衍生物经由温和的催化加氢还原制得。吡啶环5位与6位的不同缺电子氟代芳基，通过两步化学选择性交叉偶联依次引入：基于C-Br键相比于2-氯吡啶中C-Cl键具有更快的氧化加成速率，首先在5位选择性与(3-氟吡啶-4-基)硼酸反应，随后在C6位引入(2-氟苯基)硼酸。多取代吡啶前体则可由商品化的6-氯-3-硝基吡啶-2-胺通过高区域选择性的NBS溴代反应获得。全路线短捷高效，原料廉价易得。","key_disconnection_class":"urea synthesis","disconnection_type":"coupling","planned_num_steps":5,"strategy":"环状脲构筑与分步Suzuki偶联策略","route_id":1,"steps":[{"step_id":1,"product":"O=c1[nH]c2cc(-c3ccncc3F)c(-c3ccccc3F)nc2[nH]1","precursors":["Nc1cc(-c2ccncc2F)c(-c2ccccc2F)nc1N","O=C(n1ccnc1)n1ccnc1"],"reaction_class":"urea synthesis"},{"step_id":2,"product":"Nc1cc(-c2ccncc2F)c(-c2ccccc2F)nc1N","precursors":["Nc1nc(-c2ccccc2F)c(-c2ccncc2F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]"],"reaction_class":"nitro reduction"},{"step_id":3,"product":"Nc1nc(-c2ccccc2F)c(-c2ccncc2F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Nc1nc(Cl)c(-c2ccncc2F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]","OB(O)c1ccccc1F"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki coupling"},{"step_id":4,"product":"Nc1nc(Cl)c(-c2ccncc2F)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Nc1nc(Cl)c(Br)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]","OB(O)c1ccncc1F"],"reaction_class":"Suzuki coupling"},{"step_id":5,"product":"Nc1nc(Cl)c(Br)cc1[N+](=O)[O-]","precursors":["Nc1nc(Cl)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","O=C1CCC(=O)N1Br"],"reaction_class":"electrophilic aromatic halogenation"}],"starting_materials":["Nc1nc(Cl)ccc1[N+](=O)[O-]","O=C(n1ccnc1)n1ccnc1","O=C1CCC(=O)N1Br","OB(O)c1ccccc1F","OB(O)c1ccncc1F"]}]}
